Good, but flawed and crashes. I love this app as I’m someone that has a hard time finding out what products should work with my skin. I paid for the yearly subscription so I could get a full routine with products tailored to my skin concerns. Now with all that said, it’s a great app but could be better. First the app has been crashing non-stop when just looking at products. Second, I’ve had to manually click on every product as the rating may change after I click the item. Third if you do click on the product and go backwards, it scrolls you all the way to the top. Not to mention, sometimes it links to a completely different product. I also wish I could have a routine made by some of the products I’ve put “on my shelf” in the app, but that’s not the case. 

Overall it’s good at finding products that will help your skin but that’s about it. You’ll learn about good and bad ingredients but not how to use them correctly. Also the fact that I paid for the app and it crashes non-stop is a huge pain.

Great skincare analysis. This app was brought to my attention after the brand developer reached out to my skincare account on Instagram, inviting me to trial and give some feedback with no obligation to review. 

I found this to be a very accurate and helpful skin analysis tool. It was very easy to download, sign up and analyse my skin by simply uploading a good quality, well-lit photograph. 

I like that the results are followed up by product recommendations - to allow you to research further and identify the most appropriate product to implement in your regime. A handy tool on the app is also the ability to track your progress after introducing a new product via further photo uploads and scanning - each of which is saved allowing you to easily see the difference in your skin!

You can also log daily contributing factors to help problem solve what works best for your skin - documenting hydration levels and diet impact. 

A great little app that has a lot of potential. I’ll be continuing to use, and really liked it so thought fair to leave my thoughts for others to consider!
